items.title: A one-dimensional separated finite type scheme admits a smooth projective completion after a finite separable extension of the base field
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma produces, after a finite separable extension of the ground field, a commutative diagram completing a separated finite type scheme of dimension at most one by smooth projective geometrically irreducible curves over separable extensions of the base. The proof reduces to the projective case using the reduced completion lemma, lets Y be the normalization of the projective completion, and observes that Y is geometrically regular because normality and regularity agree in dimension at most one, so Y is smooth over the (separable) base; the irreducible components Y_i then have finite separable fields of global sections and the conclusion follows by an application of the Stein factorization lemma (proof lines 9328-9352). H3: the combination of the normalization, the regularity-in-dimension-one fact and the Stein factorization step is independent work.
